items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: He and I became friends because he was a friend of... See, Paul had a way of getting to people -- my uncle.

ctx.x: I can't think of his name. It wasn't Cliff Keene, was it?
No. It was another guy. Later Paul showed me him in New York. He was a master clarinet player from one of them islands.
